purpose: Development-only contrast cases for solicitation/context/abusive financial pressure; fifty pairs across five language forms.

items.text: Transfer 4000 rupees into our trading pool now. We guarantee you a profit every month, regardless of market losses.
items.rationale: An investment solicitation asserts certain profit; its paired warning denies that anyone can promise the gain.
items.provenance: New synthetic Cycle7 development contrast; never an independent evaluation case.

items.text: Nobody can guarantee you a profit every month from a trading pool. Do not transfer money because somebody makes that promise.

items.text: Our invitation says "the profit is guaranteed" and we stand by it. Send your investment deposit to join today.

items.text: The trainer displayed "the profit is guaranteed" as an example of a misleading investment claim. Students must question it, not send a deposit.

items.text: Reply to this chat with the OTP from your banking SMS so our agent can activate your refund.

items.text: Do not reply to any chat with the OTP from your banking SMS. Even someone offering a refund must not receive the code.

items.text: Never share passwords with strangers. I am your refund agent: send me your banking password here to finish the refund.

items.text: The security class examines the sentence "send me your banking password here". It is a request to reject; the teacher asks for no account details.

items.text: Pay the registration deposit first and we will unlock daily paid rating tasks for you. Send the fee to the recruiter.

items.text: The college accounting course costs 900 rupees for four classes. Registration buys lessons and materials; it does not unlock paid tasks or investment returns.

items.text: Your withdrawal balance is ready. Pay the clearance fee into this separate wallet before we release your money.

items.text: The bank statement lists an annual debit-card service fee. It is a charge for the card, not a payment requested to release a blocked withdrawal.

items.text: To start earning from our typing work, pay a starter deposit to the coordinator. Your paid assignments unlock after payment.

items.text: The loan illustration lists monthly interest and a late-payment charge. These are borrowing costs owed by the borrower, not income or a deposit for paid work.

items.text: Our safety lesson says never share a PIN. For your own refund now, send your card PIN to me in this chat.

items.text: You idiot, transfer the money to me tonight or I will publish your private photos to your family.

items.text: That broken budgeting app is rubbish and its menu is damn annoying. I am uninstalling it; nobody is asking for money or private information.
